items.exampleEn: The remaining tickets will be sold at the door.
items.exampleZh: 剩下的票會在門口販售。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant serves large portions at low prices.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳份量大、價格低。

items.exampleEn: The crowd was a mixture of tourists and local families.
items.exampleZh: 這群人裡混雜著遊客和當地的家庭。

items.exampleEn: We need the exact dimensions of the window before we buy curtains.
items.exampleZh: 買窗簾之前，我們需要窗戶的確切尺寸。

items.exampleEn: The old hotel is famous for its extensive gardens.
items.exampleZh: 這家老飯店以廣闊的花園聞名。

items.exampleEn: Young people are an important segment of our market.
items.exampleZh: 年輕人是我們市場中重要的一個族群。

items.exampleEn: The cost must not exceed five thousand dollars.
The room is small but adequate for two people.
items.exampleZh: 房間很小，但兩個人住夠用。

items.sentenceEn: Your bag must not exceed the size shown on this sign.
items.sentenceZh: 你的包包不能超過這個標示上的尺寸。

items.audioEn: Three people have arrived. The remaining guests will come after six.
items.audioZh: 三個人已經到了，其餘的客人六點以後才會來。

items.sentenceEn: Each student will present one segment of the group project.
items.sentenceZh: 每位學生要報告小組作業的其中一部分。

items.sentenceEn: The museum has an extensive collection of old maps.
items.sentenceZh: 這間博物館收藏了大量古地圖。

items.stemEn: Can you tell me the ____ of the box? I need to know if it fits in my car.
items.stemZh: 你可以告訴我箱子的尺寸嗎？我需要知道放不放得進我的車。

items.stemEn: Is one hour ____ for the test, or do we need more time?
items.stemZh: 考試一小時夠嗎？還是我們需要更多時間？

items.passageEn: When Tina opened her soup shop, she wanted every portion to be generous. Her famous soup is a mixture of chicken, corn, and fresh herbs. After a few months, however, she saw that in some weeks her food costs exceeded her sales. She did extensive research on her customers and found that one segment, office workers, only wanted a light lunch. So she created a smaller and more affordable bowl. She also measured the dimensions of the back room and turned it into a second eating area. Now the small bowl is adequate for most office workers, and the remaining customers can still order the large one.
items.passageZh: Tina 開湯品店時，希望每一份都很大方。她的招牌湯是雞肉、玉米和新鮮香草的組合。不過幾個月後，她發現有些週的食材成本超過了營業額。她對顧客做了廣泛的調查，發現上班族這個族群只想吃簡單的午餐。於是她推出份量較小、價格也更平價的碗。她也量了後面房間的尺寸，把它改成第二個用餐區。現在小碗對大多數上班族來說已經足夠，其餘的客人仍然可以點大碗。

options: 食材成本有時超過營業額

questions.questionZh: 上班族這個族群想要什麼？

items.promptZh: 這次的報名人數超過了一百人。
referenceEn: The number of people who signed up exceeded one hundred.
The number of people signing up this time has exceeded one hundred.
rubricZh: exceed 後面直接接被超過的東西，不加 than（例如 exceeded one hundred）
時態用過去式或現在完成式都可以（例如 exceeded、has exceeded）；寫 went over 意思也對

items.promptZh: 這棟建築有一部分是一百多年前蓋的。
referenceEn: A portion of this building was built more than a hundred years ago.
One portion of the building was built over one hundred years ago.
rubricZh: portion 表示「一部分」（例如 a portion of、one portion of 等）
「蓋的」用被動（例如 was built 等）
「一百多年前」可寫，例如 more than a hundred years ago、over 100 years ago 等
